episodes.title: Rainbow Palette
episodes.summary: Hana's mentor Kenji plans a special birthday dinner, but tragedy strikes. Meanwhile, Sosuke's big presentation falls apart when someone touches him.

episodes.title: Truffles Yuzu
episodes.summary: When the shop's yuzu supplier cuts them off, Sosuke drags a reluctant Hana on a road trip to smooth things over — and to her delight, asks Hiro to drive.

episodes.title: Wasabi en Soie
episodes.summary: Sosuke and the chocolatiers clash over the wasabi chocolate recipe. Later, Hana suggests she and Sosuke practice making eye contact and physical touch.

episodes.title: Bonbon Sakura
episodes.summary: Right before Hana's long-awaited rendezvous with Hiro, Sosuke begs for her help with a notoriously tough supplier. Will she bail on her dream date again?

episodes.title: Spécial Orangette
episodes.summary: Hoping to recreate a flavor from 30 years ago, the team reconnects with an old chocolatier while Sosuke discovers an unexpected connection to his past.

episodes.title: Two-way Confiserie
episodes.summary: In search of inspiration, the Le Sauveur team heads to Nagano. Hana and Sosuke sort out their tangled feelings. Hiro tags along, hoping to see Irene.

episodes.title: Pure Kenji
episodes.summary: With Le Sauveur's fate hinging on a contest, the team struggles to recreate their signature bonbon. Hana offers to help but risks exposing her secret.

episodes.title: Chocolat du Bonheur
episodes.summary: While Sosuke wrestles with a power struggle at Futago Confectionery, Hana faces her fears under many watchful eyes. Can they finally taste happiness?
